overview: Built a GoHighLevel automation system for a restaurant to manage inbound leads, outbound follow ups, appointment bookings, and customer communication from one CRM.
The setup includes separate workflows for inbound and outbound campaigns, dedicated agents, appointment handling, and automated email communication.

blocks.p: The system was organized inside a dedicated restaurant subaccount with separate automation areas for:
The outbound setup includes workflows for:
Leads are enrolled into the appropriate workflow and moved through the follow up process based on the outcome of the interaction.
The inbound setup handles incoming customer interactions and connects them with the appropriate booking and follow up workflows.
This allows new inquiries to be processed without relying entirely on manual responses.
The system also manages appointment related communication through GoHighLevel.
Customer records contain contact information and conversation history, while automated emails are used to confirm appointment details and provide the required information to the customer.
Separate inbound and outbound agents were configured within the restaurant subaccount, keeping the two communication processes organized and easier to manage.

result: A centralized restaurant lead management system that connects lead generation, inbound and outbound communication, appointment booking, follow ups, and customer emails inside GoHighLevel.
The setup gives the restaurant a structured process for handling leads and customer interactions from the first contact through appointment confirmation.
